environment.description: Same Lambda function deployed in account 444555666777. The API Gateway is configured as PRIVATE type with resource policy restricting invoke to vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890. The VPC endpoint (com.amazonaws.us-east-1.execute-api) is provisioned in a subnet with NACL rules allowing inbound only from 10.0.8.0/24 (the internal auth-service subnet). The VPC has no internet gateway, no NAT gateway, and no VPC peering to any VPC with internet egress. DNS resolution for the API Gateway custom domain resolves only via the VPC endpoint's private DNS. The security group on the VPC endpoint ENIs (sg-0abc123def456) allows inbound TCP/443 only from sg-0fed654cba321 (auth-service security group). Route tables for all subnets in the VPC contain no route to 0.0.0.0/0.
